title: B3.13 vs D1.1 in dairy cattle — convergence at the polymerase·ANP32 interface
caption: B3.13 (Texas, Feb 2024; 13 states by July) is the established cattle lineage with a non-canonical signature: PB2 M631L fixed in all sequences + PA K497R, adapting polymerase to bovine ANP32 without E627K. D1.1 (Wisconsin, 2025, bulk milk) is a later independent spillover from local avian viruses that acquired the classic PB2 E627K de novo. Two routes to the same destination — screen for both.
